# Sidhi & Associates

> Sidhi & Associates is an ICAI-registered Chartered Accountancy firm in India providing tax filing, GST compliance, company incorporation, audit, bookkeeping, and business advisory services. The firm serves 5,000+ clients across 13+ offices pan-India, with services starting from ₹1,000 for ITR filing and ₹1,500 for GST registration.

## Company
- Website: https://sidhiandassociates.com
- Contact: +91 78892 57045
- Services: Income Tax Filing & Planning, GST Registration & Compliance, Company Incorporation (Pvt Ltd, LLP, OPC, Partnership), Audit & Assurance, Bookkeeping & Accounting, Business Advisory, NRI Services
